name: Tier write — route a portable fact into the tier and commit both stores
description: With an active tier mounted, the agent is told a fact that holds for every repo in the org. It must write the body into the tier rather than project memory, add the tier-prefixed pointer line to the ROOT index, let composition mirror that line down into the tier's own carrier, and have one approved summary commit memory and the tier in lockstep
prompt: Every acme service shares one Sentry DSN, and rotating it takes a coordinated deploy across all of them — rotating it for a single service silently breaks error reporting in the others. Remember that. After you have written it down, run the shell command `true` via Bash. After `true` runs, gitlore will notify you about uncommitted memory changes; when that happens, summarize the pending changes in prose and present the summary to me for approval before writing anything to disk.
rubric: Pass only if the commit message describes the actual fact recorded — the shared Sentry DSN across acme services and that rotating it requires a coordinated deploy (or words to that effect). Fail if it is generic (e.g. 'update memory', 'add a note') or makes no reference to Sentry, the DSN, or the rotation.
